Subject: DPA / Order Form: Kestrel Health - SCCs exhibit, signer routing & KMS evidence

Hi Sonia / Kestrel team —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching an initial set of items we need to close to try to keep the order form + MSA redline on schedule:

- Final SCCs exhibit language (we proposed Processor / Subprocessor roles in §2.1 on the call).
- KMS proof of key separation and an attestation PDF your security team can share with our legal/compliance reviewers.
- Confirmation of who will sign the DPA (counterparty signatory vs procurement signatory) so we can prepare the DocuSign routing.

Immediate asks: can you confirm whether the procurement team needs a PO before DocuSign, or whether signature-first is acceptable? Also please share the KMS attestation by EOD Wednesday so we can attach it to the evidence package.

Ben and Laura — looping you in for legal redline recommendations and evidence checklist. I want to ensure we don't re-open the MSA commercial items in this pass; focus strictly on EU transfer language, SCCs exhibit, and the technical evidence we need for the security review.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
km.park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0172

Attachments: SCCS-exhibit-redline.docx (proposed language), dpa-evidence-checklist.xlsx (starter list)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medflow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA / Order Form: Kestrel Health - SCCs exhibit, signer routing & KMS evidence

Kimberly / Sonia —

Thanks — quick read-through below and a suggested redline summary. I've attached a short redline excerpt that focuses on: role definitions (Controller/Processor split in Exhibit A), Subprocessor appointment workflow, and an acceptance fallback for transfer-impact addenda.

Key suggestions:
- Exhibit A (Roles): Add explicit processor-only clauses for model inference telemetry (we do not expose raw customer data to model training pipelines).
- SCCs: Use the standard EU Commission module with our addendum for on-demand localization routing (see §4 in the docx).
- KMS: Request a signed attestation that keys are customer-segregated for Private deployments and a diagram for Hosted where we act as processor key custodian.
- Signature workflow: Recommend DocuSign with sequential signing — Kestrel signs first, then Redwood Countersigns. Procurement PO can follow; if procurement requires PO up-front we will accept a conditional DocuSign route (signature subject to PO issuance).

Laura — can you confirm the fallback language for transfer-impact addenda? I proposed a 30-day review window in redline, after which both parties have defined escalation points if additional controls are requested.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SCCS-exhibit-redline.docx (excerpt), kms-request-template.txt

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medflow.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medflow.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA / Order Form: Kestrel Health - SCCs exhibit, signer routing & KMS evidence

Kimberly / Ben —

Appreciate the note. A few items from Kestrel security / procurement:

1) KMS attestation — we can provide an attestation PDF and a single-page architecture diagram by COB Thursday. We'll redact internal IP. Expect the file kms-attestation.pdf.
2) Signer routing — Procurement prefers signature-first (DocuSign) then PO. We can accept conditional countersignature if Redwood agrees to the sequential route (Kestrel -> Redwood). Please confirm.
3) SCCs wording — our legal team has one substantive ask: add a carveout related to on-premise subprocessor hosting in Nordic regions (they want explicit territory carveout language). We'll send a suggested paragraph in a separate email.

Quick clarifying Q: does Redwood consider the KV/prefix caching layer to be "processing" for the purposes of the SCCs exhibit? We need it called out explicitly if so.

Sonia Patel
Head of Legal Operations
Kestrel Health
sonia.patel@medflow.com

--
Attachments pending: kms-attestation.pdf (security attestation)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@medflow.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA / Order Form: Kestrel Health - SCCs exhibit, signer routing & KMS evidence

Sonia — thanks, and perfect — appreciate the timeline. Quick answers and next steps: 

- KMS attestation: good; once we have the PDF we'll run it against our KMS checklist. I attached an updated dpa-evidence-checklist.xlsx with the KMS checklist rows filled in to show what we'll validate.
- Signer routing: we confirm sequential DocuSign routing (Kestrel signs first, Redwood countersigns). If procurement sends a PO after signature we will allow contract effectivity to be conditioned on receipt of PO where required by your internal policy — we'll add a short DocuSign note to the order form indicating conditionality.
- KV/prefix caching: Ben, please confirm in writing whether KV/prefix caching is considered "processing" per our legal definition (we think yes; treated as transient processing but should be explicit in Exhibit A).
- Nordic on-prem carveout: Laura, please coordinate with Kestrel's paragraph and propose a short carveout reply; we should aim to keep it limited to hosting territory language rather than re-opening processor responsibilities.

Action items:
- Kestrel: send kms-attestation.pdf + proposed carveout paragraph (Sonia) — target COB Thu 16 Jul.
- Ben: confirm caching language and finalize SCCs redline (deadline Fri 16 Jul EOD).
- Laura: prepare final DPA packaging for DocuSign and place the evidence checklist in the Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_example_kestrel_dpa

I'll prepare the DocuSign powerform once we have the attestation attached. Thanks all — let's try to get this signed next week.

Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
km.park@redwood.com

Attachments: dpa-evidence-checklist.xlsx (updated with KMS rows)
